symbolDescription:
Fine-grained sanitizer configuration.

Anything omitted falls back to the profile the config is merged onto (`standard` by
default). The hard rules cannot be re-enabled from here.

optionDescriptions.allowTags: Tag allowlist. Replaces the profile's list when given.
optionDescriptions.allowAttributes: Attribute allowlist per tag. The `'*'` key applies to every tag.
optionDescriptions.allowClasses: Class-name allowlist. Strings match exactly; regexes are tested against the name.
optionDescriptions.allowDataUrls: Allow `data:` URLs, optionally restricted to specific MIME types.
optionDescriptions.linkRel: `rel` forced onto links that open in a new tab.
optionDescriptions.transform: Per-element hook. Return the element, `null` to drop it, or `'unwrap'` to keep its children.
